children: According to Axios, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said in a Fortune interview released Saturday that the company will not go public this year because it still has significant safety work to do. Altman said it would be an ill-advised time to pursue an IPO and added, "I would say not 2026, yeah. We got a lot of stuff to do."

title: Sam Altman Says OpenAI Won't Go Public This Year
